knowledge_gaps: The proposed ablation changes both recent-interest fusion and normalization. LayerNorm(base + gate * recent) generally differs from the baseline even when the gate is zero. Include a normalization-only control and fixed-gate pooling to isolate the learned gate's contribution.

The residual coefficient is bounded, but its magnitude relative to SASRec features is not: embedding norms can grow. Specify embedding scaling, normalization, dropout placement, gate inputs and architecture, initialization of all gate weights, cosine epsilon, decay normalization, and behavior for empty or single-item prefixes.

Adjacent embedding agreement measures learned similarity rather than repeated intent. Because embeddings also determine candidate scores, the gate could exploit embedding norms or popularity correlations. Compare against last-item and fixed-decay pooling controls, and inspect gate behavior by history length and training-item popularity.

No measured baseline validation HR@10, evaluation cadence, checkpoint-selection rule, or trial budget allocation is supplied. With only 200 validation users per category, repeated checkpoint and hyperparameter selection can overfit validation. Define a small comparison plan within the shared GPU budget.

The originality rating of 4 is plausible for an incremental adaptation, but potential and difficulty scores remain subjective. Stronger comparisons with established local/global interest fusion methods would better support them. Mean pairwise cosine similarity also cannot rule out other forms of representation collapse.
